CaptureBudget.description: Capture configuration. These defaults configure optional work, never missing facts.

memory_bytes.description: In-process exporter working allowance. External tools have their own working sets.

output_bytes.description: Total retained capture file allowance, including raw samples and converted profiles.

DetailRequirement.description: Source coverage requested independently from scientific validity.

oneOf.description: Deliberate finite sampling; never described as complete iterations.
Every source record in the selected family/interval must be retained.

description: Explicit selection acknowledged before future invocation children are constructed.

boundary_thread_cpu.description: Select CPU clocks only at actual synchronous callback boundaries.

duration.description: Maximum window from acknowledgement, or earlier explicit owner completion.

expiry_monotonic_ns.description: Original same-host CLOCK_MONOTONIC deadline; queued child starts cannot renew it.

families.description: Exact versioned source families; absent/unsupported families remain incomplete.

managed_budget.description: Explicit additional managed-group allowance, granted once; never copied from local budget.

output.description: Exclusive new output directory, owned by this selected capture only.

sample_every.description: Retain one of every N observed selected-family records; complete requires one.

title: DetailRequest
